finding: The remaining B01-wet failure is localized to a high-conductivity wet interval. The floor-scaled log-K gate is satisfied, but a roughly 0.061 percent relative K error at K about 16.87 cm/day corresponds to a non-negligible absolute conductivity error. Retention error in the same interval is negligible.
design_implication: A robust K metric should control both relative/floor-scaled error in dry conditions and Ksat-normalized absolute error in wet high-K conditions.
nonclaims: No B01-specific production knot is justified.
The proposed mixed metric still requires prospective qualification.
